clarification_title: H39 Baseline Specification and Reference Entry Timing Clarification

reference_entry_semantics.decision_close_rule: decision_close_ms = slot_ms (close timestamp of the 15m decision period)
reference_entry_semantics.reference_entry_rule: OPEN of first fully available 1m bar strictly after decision close (decision_close_ms + 60_000)
reference_entry_semantics.reference_price_rule: OPEN of 1m candle starting at reference_candle_open_ms
reference_entry_semantics.prohibition: Reference candle is strictly never the candle beginning at decision_close_ms

baseline_specification.baseline_model: Deterministic L2-regularized Logistic Regression / LPM for 60m direction
baseline_specification.regularization: Fixed L2 strength equivalent to C=1.0 (lambda = 1.0), intercept unpenalized, no tuning

source_fields_and_timeframes.close_15m_ago: Close of 1m candle closing at decision_close_ms - 15 * 60_000
source_fields_and_timeframes.close_60m_ago: Close of 1m candle closing at decision_close_ms - 60 * 60_000
source_fields_and_timeframes.ATR14_15m_known_at_decision: 14-period ATR on 15m bars known at decision time <= decision_close_ms

baseline_specification.causality_rule: All feature events strictly satisfy event_time_ms <= decision_close_ms and receive_time_ms <= decision_close_ms. All source candles for baseline features strictly have close timestamps <= decision_close_ms.

incremental_information_testing.lr_p_value_formula: 1.0 - math.erf(math.sqrt(max(0.0, LR) / 2.0)) for 1-df chi-square survival function
incremental_information_testing.microstructure_coefficient_statistic: z = beta_micro / sqrt(covariance[micro, micro]) where covariance = inv(X'WX + lambda*I)
incremental_information_testing.candidate_eligibility_requirement: Requires passing both primary Holm familywise gate and repaired incremental information test

contamination_attestation.statement: Zero fresh post-start 60m validation outcomes were inspected before this clarification manifest was committed.
